wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 07-008 wires the finale runtime through one src/vanilla facade (wireFinaleRuntime.ts) re-exporting the read-only src/ui/finale.ts: the text-reveal/cast-call/bunny-scroll state machine entry points (createFinaleState, getFinaleScreen, startFinale, tickFinale, getVisibleCharacterCount), the per-episode flat/art/text constants (E1_FLAT..E4_FLAT, E2_ART_LUMP VICTORY2, E4_ART_LUMP ENDPIC, E1_TEXT..E4_TEXT, BUNNY_SCROLL_LUMPS ['PFUB1','PFUB2']), the timing/sequence constants (TEXTSPEED 3, TEXTWAIT 250, FINALE_TEXT_START_DELAY 10, FINALE_COMMERCIAL_SKIP_DELAY 50, FINALE_CAST_MAP 30, MAXPLAYERS 4), and the FinaleGameMode/FinaleInput/FinaleMusicCue/FinaleScreen/FinaleStartResult/FinaleState/FinaleTickResult types (split value/type re-exports under verbatimModuleSyntax; FinaleGameMode and FinaleMusicCue are type aliases, not const enums, so they are surfaced as types). VANILLA_FINALE_RUNTIME_INVARIANTS pins five rules (episode-3 bunny scroll uses PFUB1/PFUB2; cast call is the commercial MAP30 sequence; finale text types at TEXTSPEED then waits TEXTWAIT; finale music is victor-then-bunny; tickFinale signals the transition exit). The focused test is inventory-neutral: it exercises the real constants, the getFinaleScreen/createFinaleState return shapes, the typeof of every re-exported function, the frozen five-rule manifest, the ../-filtered single-specifier set ['../ui/finale.ts'], and dynamic same-reference identity against src/ui/finale.ts. This step became eligible with prerequisites 08-009 and 11-007 both COMPLETED.
